note: The table items: cosmetic platform items only the server grants. The one place a table's slug, id and title live; read by src/net/tables.ts (the game), tools/server/make-config.mts (the game config) and functions/checker/build.rs (which board grants which table). An id never changes once uploaded. The built-in snowy dusk table (table-winter-dusk) is every player's and is no item.
